hook.name: Etherlab
hook.description: ERC-20/hook combo ($LAB token) that takes a 3% ETH fee on every swap and distributes it between a holder reward pool (70%, weighted by hold duration) and a per-round restore bonus pool (30%). A shared stability counter rises on qualifying buys and falls on qualifying sells; reaching 100% distributes the restore pool to eligible holders, while hitting 0% rolls it over to the next round.
